data.name: Dyuthika
data.gender_notes: Dyuthika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dyuthika is a Sanskrit name for a radiant, shining one. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'dyuti', meaning 'light' or 'shining'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity. The name Dyuthika carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dyuthika usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Dyuthika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant, Shining One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dyuthika total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
